[00:02:10] lead-example: Decision one: we release on Thursdays from now on. Tuesday releases kept colliding with the on-call handover.
[00:03:00] dev-example: Fine by me.
[00:04:30] dev-example: Second thing. Every job pins the harness by digest, not by channel name.
[00:04:45] lead-example: Agreed, pin by digest. A channel can move under a running job.
[00:06:05] dev-example: I'll write the release checklist by Friday the 14th.
